items.text: Fixed netgraph being offscreen due to scaling and shifting.
Prevent teammates from using the break‑in option to enter a teammate's room.
Fixed teammates being unable to exit rooms after a server restart, restoring the ability for anyone to let themselves out.
Fixed a bug that allowed water sources (sinks) to be transferred between rooms, preventing unintended resource movement.
Added a transition from startle to flee state for critters when they get hurt while startled, improving animal behavior.
Fixed a null reference error caused by destroyed elevator floors during save, preventing crashes.
Fixed mortar desynchronization when reconnecting or entering network range, ensuring consistent mortar behavior.
Moved the Radtown loot crate farther from the window to reduce cheating opportunities.
Relocated the loot crate in the Trainyard powergrid loot room and added plywood and collider blockers to windows and railings.
Boarded up gaps in Harbor 1 that allowed shooting into the loot room.
Sealed all windows in Harbor 2 that let players look into and shoot the loot room.
Crabs now respect step height and avoid clipping into cliffs or walls; leg speed glitch fixed; jellyfish water checks optimized.
Frogs' first jump distance corrected and dead‑animation lock resolved.
Frog size increased by 20% (x1.2).
Critter health nerfed: frogs to 60 HP, rabbits to 100 HP (turtles unchanged).
Bull AI rotation bug fixed when target is lost during observation.
Livestock now moves at the same speed as the player when being led, preventing lead breaks and long waits.
Floating livestock bug fixed, improving idle behavior.
Added open fence gates to the ranch and large barn, improving access to the vendor area.
Biofuel generator is now silent while idle.
Cold overlay no longer lingers after exiting cold zones.
Mortar camera animation now plays correctly in builds.
Crossbow arrows now have correct head rotation when fired without a bow, fixing trajectory issues.
Livestock vendor inventories are now filtered by game mode; guns are no longer sold in Primitive mode.

Vendor sales updated: low‑quality turrets removed, high‑end sales now include BP fragments and firearms (Thompson, Custom SMG, Python, HC Revolver); wool sales now account for ~75% of livestock revenue.
Fixed mortar desync when reconnecting or entering network range, preventing weapon synchronization issues.
Corrected crossbow arrow head rotation for bowless crossbows, ensuring arrows fly in the intended direction.
Closed gaps and windows that allowed shooting into the Harbor 1 and Harbor 2 loot rooms.
Fixed bug that let water sources be transferred between rooms (sinks).
Added open fence gates to the ranch and large barn for easier access to the vendor.
Livestock now matches player speed when being led, reducing lead breaks.
Frogs are now 20% larger, have reduced health to 60, and feature a corrected first jump, making them easier to encounter.
Crabs received step‑height, obstacle‑avoidance, and leg‑speed improvements; jellyfish swarms added and water checks batched for better performance.
Bull AI rotation fixed when losing target, per‑frame animation allocation reduced, and floating animal idle performance improved.

Livestock vendor inventory updated: duplicate Custom SMG replaced with Thompson, items filtered by game mode, low‑quality turrets removed, high‑end sales now include BP fragments and weapons, and wool now makes up ~75% of sales.
Biofuel generator is now completely silent while idle, removing its background hum.

2026-09-28.summary:
### Combat
- Fixed mortar desync when reconnecting or entering network range, preventing weapon synchronization issues.
- Corrected crossbow arrow head rotation for bowless crossbows, ensuring arrows fly in the intended direction.

### Map & Loot Rooms
- Closed gaps and windows that allowed shooting into the Harbor 1 and Harbor 2 loot rooms.

### Base Building
- Fixed bug that let water sources be transferred between rooms (sinks).
- Added open fence gates to the ranch and large barn for easier access to the vendor.

### Animals & Wildlife
- Livestock now matches player speed when being led, reducing lead breaks.
- Frogs are now 20% larger, have reduced health to 60, and feature a corrected first jump, making them easier to encounter.
- Crabs received step‑height, obstacle‑avoidance, and leg‑speed improvements; jellyfish swarms added and water checks batched for better performance.
- Bull AI rotation fixed when losing target, per‑frame animation allocation reduced, and floating animal idle performance improved.

### Economy & Vendors
- Livestock vendor inventory updated: duplicate Custom SMG replaced with Thompson, items filtered by game mode, low‑quality turrets removed, high‑end sales now include BP fragments and weapons, and wool now makes up ~75% of sales.

### Audio
- Biofuel generator is now completely silent while idle, removing its background hum.

items.text: Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.
Cows can no longer graze on ice or sand, preventing them from wasting resources on unsuitable terrain.
Animal fence gate durability reduced from 500 HP to 100 HP, making them easier to break.
Country tag now respects streamer mode, hiding the player's country when the setting is enabled.

2026-09-27.summary:
### Livestock & Animals
- Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
- Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
- Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.
- Cows can no longer graze on ice or sand, preventing them from wasting resources on unsuitable terrain.

### Structures
- Animal fence gate durability reduced from 500 HP to 100 HP, making them easier to break.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Country tag now respects streamer mode, hiding the player's country when the setting is enabled.

2026-09-26.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.
